basic_info.main_problem: 与烹饪skill相关的Self-doubt与not充分感，源于一次将意面做得过咸的失误后开始加重，并逐渐认为烹饪失败反映了自己缺乏自豪感与努力。
basic_info.core_demands: Sought counseling because these feelings affected self-esteem and enjoyment of cooking.
growth_experiences: 几周前一次烹饪失误（意面做得过咸）成为转折点：此前，烹饪是自我表达与创造力的来源并令其感到自豪；事件后，每次下厨都感到必须做到完美，一旦not如Anticipation便产生强烈Self-doubt与自我批评，将一次失误泛化为能力not足与缺乏自豪感/努力，进而影响学业专注与对烹饪、海边休闲等活动的享受。

special_situations.event: A cooking mistake of making the pasta too salty once
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果菜品失败，就说明我have not自豪感/not够努力/not具备能力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forces herself to improve by pursuing perfection and intensifying self-criticism
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这说明我not够努力、have not能力。

special_situations.event: 菜品整体表现not错时仍挑出瑕疵并negate成就
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要有一点缺陷，就可以证明I am a terrible cook
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 持续Self-monitoring与挑错，主动忽视或negate积极反馈

special_situations.event: 烹饪not如Anticipation后对学业专注与表现造成影响
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Failure in the kitchen means I will fail in other areas too
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeated worry and rumination, restoring self-worth by controlling cooking performance

special_situations.event: Every time she cooks, feels she must make it perfect, otherwise it is failure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有达到完美才算有价值；not完美等于失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Raises standards, exerts enormous pressure, pursues zero errors
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我必须做到完美，否则就是一without是处。

core_conflict.wish: 渴望通过能力与完美表现Gaining recognition与自尊
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败被视为without能、失去自我价值与骄傲
defense_goal: Maintains control through perfectionism and self-criticism, avoiding failure and shame

object_relations.self_representation: not够好、需要靠完美证明价值的人
object_relations.object_representation: Others (generalized evaluators) will harshly measure me by success or failure
Cooking as a harsh testing ground, an object with a low tolerance for error

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当菜品not如Anticipation或回想“过咸的意面”失误时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将一次失误视为自身without能与not努力的证据（把失败内化为稳定缺陷）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use自责、苛刻的语气评价自己，忽略积极面，强调“我not够努力/have not能力”。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 面对not完美或细微瑕疵时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将好与坏完全Splitting，非黑即白地认定“not完美=失败”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responds with absolutist wording (such as 'either perfect or a failure'), refusing a middle position.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about the cause of a mistake or needing to explain performance
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 以看似合理的因果推断为自我贬低辩护，如“因为我not够努力/have not自豪感所以失败”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 采用理性、冷静语气给出“努力not足”等解释，弱化情感层面的体验。

manifestations: Cooking was once a source of self-expression and creativity and a sense of pride; after mistakes, the sense of meaning declined, and it became hard to enjoy cooking and leisure again (such as going to the beach)
Bound by the inner rule of 'must be perfect', hard to be self-compassionate and relax

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Self-describes as 'must do it perfectly', taking the result as the only standard
将“not完美=失败”视为绝对规则

manifestations: not yet向朋友或家人倾诉not充分感，转而进行自我批评与内耗

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and introspection abilities, involving excessive self-restriction and self-reproach, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Harshly scrutinizes oneself at almost every cooking session
即使表现Good也挑出缺点并negate积极体验

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent self-criticism and self-deprecation after cooking
antecedent: 回想“过咸的意面”的失误
target_behavior.core_reason: 将一次失误个人化并过度概括为稳定的without能，伴随“应该完美”的Introjection规则
target_behavior.function: 通过自我惩罚与Reinforcement控制感来试图避免再次失败（逃避羞耻）
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-esteem、Rising stress、享受感减少，进一步影响学业专注

target_behavior.behavior: 在烹饪过程中的过度完美主义与苛刻Self-monitoring
target_behavior.core_reason: Believes only perfection counts as valuable; any flaw is failure
target_behavior.function: Avoids criticism and failure; maintains self-worth
target_behavior.consequence: 紧张与Increased anxiety，过程体验受损，错误容忍度降低

target_behavior.behavior: Repeated worry and rumination around cooking affect academic focus
target_behavior.core_reason: 将烹饪表现等同于总体能力并担心not yet来再次失败
